text: Cabrales is finished in limestone caves of the Picos de Europa whose draughts carry Penicillium roqueforti spores off the walls onto the cheese, where they germinate and spread through the paste. The cold, saturated cave air and two to five months on wooden shelves give its strong blue veining.
